svg.title: A residual-noise choice must also retain the wanted signal
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: A residual-noise choice must also retain the wanted signal
Wanted and nuisance phase at the same input have the same transfer
At fc = 100 Hz, a wanted 1 Hz phase has residual amplitude gain 0.0099995.
S₀ = 10⁻⁶ rad²/Hz on |f| ≤ 1000 Hz; Ω = π rad/s
RMS criterion met for fc ≈ 28.27–134.33 Hz; no joint wanted-signal limit was set.
Centered noise and deterministic bias are combined as √(variance + bias²).
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
